name: Does the Denver climate affect how bathroom drywall should be installed?

mainEntity.name: Does the Denver climate affect how bathroom drywall should be installed?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, bathrooms in the Denver metro area require dedicated attention to ventilation and seasonal moisture control. While Colorado has a naturally semi-arid climate, the sharp difference between cold outdoor temperatures and hot indoor shower steam causes rapid condensation on exterior-facing bathroom walls. Denver and regional building codes require either an operable window or a properly ducted mechanical exhaust fan vented to the outdoors. Ensuring your drywall installation integrates tightly around properly sized exhaust ducts prevents warm, moist air from migrating into attic spaces or cold exterior wall cavities.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes. Colorado's cold winters create heavy indoor condensation, making proper exhaust fan venting and moisture-resistant board crucial on exterior-facing bathroom walls.
